color.note: Mosaic's own blues lead; glaze colours from Gaudí's trencadís (turquoise, terracotta, saffron, olive, majolica, ceramic) support, each with one job so colour always means something. The mark-* tokens colour the logo and the state icons. The app's grounds are neutral; one colour per type comes from type-1 to type-16.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Mosaic's dark blue. Logo, wordmark, hero and header grounds. The colour people should remember Mosaic by.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: the app's header band, cover blocks. Navy in both themes; the only navy surface in the app.

tokens.name: grout
tokens.usage: The gaps between shards on dark grounds. Never used for text.

tokens.name: ground-shard
tokens.usage: Background shards on navy. Keep within ±3% lightness of brand-navy so text on top stays readable.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The app's page ground, behind panes and cards. Neutral in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes, cards, tables and the row of places. Neutral in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Selection and hover: the selected row, tab or chip, and highlight panels. ink and heading pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces that float over the page: menus, the search results, summaries.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow under raised surfaces: menus, the search results.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The selected or hovered item's ground; the same colour as surface-tint.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent, as on a primary button.

tokens.name: band-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the header band.

tokens.name: band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and placeholders on the header band.

tokens.name: band-field
tokens.usage: The search field's ground on the header band.

tokens.name: band-field-line
tokens.usage: The search field's outline on the header band: 3:1 on the band.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings, step titles and bold leads, on surface or surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface or surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, secondary lines. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and page in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Section labels, links, the current place's underline, primary buttons. 5:1 on white; the dark value passes on the dark surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines (the mockup's line). Decorative only: not for controls that need 3:1.

tokens.name: mark-base
tokens.usage: The logo mark and state icons: the two outer settled pieces. Light value on white grounds, dark value on navy.

tokens.name: mark-mid
tokens.usage: The logo mark and state icons: the middle settled piece.

tokens.name: mark-piece
tokens.usage: The last piece: the one being set in the mark, and the tessera icon. Saffron on both grounds: the one warm piece in the mark. Always this colour, always that shape.

tokens.name: mark-line
tokens.usage: The pattern icon's lines and the embedded icon's frame.

tokens.name: shard-1
tokens.usage: Series colour 1 for data-driven mosaics and charts: one category per colour. Also the last piece of the mark on navy.

tokens.name: shard-2
tokens.usage: Series colour 2.

tokens.name: shard-3
tokens.usage: Series colour 3. Also the hover shade of primary buttons.

tokens.name: shard-4
tokens.usage: Series colour 4. Also the category line and secondary text on navy.

tokens.name: shard-5
tokens.usage: Series colour 5.

tokens.name: shard-6
tokens.usage: Series colour 6; the lightest shard.

tokens.name: shard-7
tokens.usage: Series colour 7.

tokens.name: type-1
tokens.usage: Type colour 1: cobalt. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-2
tokens.usage: Type colour 2: turquoise. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-3
tokens.usage: Type colour 3: terracotta. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-4
tokens.usage: Type colour 4: plum. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-5
tokens.usage: Type colour 5: slate. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-6
tokens.usage: Type colour 6: rose. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-7
tokens.usage: Type colour 7: sky. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-8
tokens.usage: Type colour 8: umber. At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-9
tokens.usage: Type colour 9: cobalt, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-10
tokens.usage: Type colour 10: turquoise, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-11
tokens.usage: Type colour 11: terracotta, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-12
tokens.usage: Type colour 12: plum, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-13
tokens.usage: Type colour 13: slate, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-14
tokens.usage: Type colour 14: rose, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-15
tokens.usage: Type colour 15: sky, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-16
tokens.usage: Type colour 16: umber, second step (darker on the light surface, lighter on the dark one). At least 3:1 on surface in each theme.

tokens.name: type-colour
tokens.usage: The colour of the type an element shows. An element with data-type-colour="1" to "16" gets the matching type colour; without one, this neutral.

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Secondary. Time series and other external data in diagrams and charts: borders, icons, chart series. Glaze colour from Park Güell's trencadís. In the app it is a type colour only.

tokens.name: turquoise-tint
tokens.usage: Background of external-data areas and chips.

tokens.name: turquoise-text
tokens.usage: Turquoise text: 7:1 on turquoise-tint, passes on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Secondary. Documents and highlights in diagrams and charts: borders, icons, chart series. Not for text on white (3.9:1). In the app it is a type colour only.

tokens.name: terracotta-tint
tokens.usage: Background of document areas and highlight chips.

tokens.name: terracotta-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta text: 5.7:1 on white, passes on terracotta-tint.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Accent. Proposals awaiting a decision (from AI, matchers or linkers), warnings, attention. Fills and icons only; never text on white (1.8:1).

tokens.name: saffron-tint
tokens.usage: Background of proposed items and warning banners.

tokens.name: saffron-text
tokens.usage: Text on saffron-tint and saffron-coloured labels.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Status only: success, accepted. Always with an icon or label: indistinguishable from terracotta and majolica for some colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: olive-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success banners and accepted items.

tokens.name: olive-text
tokens.usage: Success text: 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: majolica
tokens.usage: Status only: errors and rejected proposals. Never decorative. Always with an icon or label.

tokens.name: majolica-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and rejected items.

tokens.name: majolica-text
tokens.usage: Error text on white or majolica-tint.

tokens.name: ceramic
tokens.usage: Optional warm background for marketing pieces and covers. App screens stay on surface.

tokens.name: data-reference
tokens.usage: Category: tables, structured files and code. Diagrams, charts, chips.

tokens.name: data-external
tokens.usage: Category: time series and other external data, kept outside the mosaic and reached by key.

tokens.name: data-documents
tokens.usage: Category: documents.

tokens.name: data-pattern
tokens.usage: Category: the pattern (types, properties, relations, checks).

tokens.name: ai-proposal
tokens.usage: Anything a machine proposed (AI, a matcher, a linker) that nobody has decided on yet.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational states.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success and accepted states, with a check icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending review, with a warning icon.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Errors and rejected states, with an error icon.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: App focus ring: 2px, 2px offset, on every control. Never removed.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name as a wordmark: lockups, covers, title slides. Always MOSAIC in capitals, in brand-navy or white; in running text write Mosaic. Scale freely; keep the 3px tracking proportional (0.04em).

styles.name: category
styles.usage: The category line under the wordmark, in accent (or shard-4 on navy).

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: A built mosaic is one read-only SQLite file: every thing your sources mention, typed, linked and traced to where it came from.
styles.usage: The definition line and other one-sentence statements.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Many pieces in. One picture out.
styles.usage: The tagline, on navy in #E6EEF8; “One picture out.” may be saffron, bold.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section labels, set in UPPERCASE, in accent.

styles.name: body-print
styles.sample: Search T_1889 to see its date, where it is recorded and every place it is mentioned.
styles.usage: Body text in printed A4 pieces (never below 12px).

styles.name: body-screen
styles.sample: Rules link what the data already says. Machines propose the rest; people decide what enters.
styles.usage: Body text on screens and slides.

styles.name: body-app
styles.sample: Five kinds of thing and how they connect.
styles.usage: Body text in the app: places, panes, menus and search results.

styles.name: label-app
styles.usage: The current place, a result's name and other emphasised text in the app.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Each shard is one thing in the built mosaic, coloured by its type.

styles.name: heading-app
styles.usage: A place's heading and a card's name in the app, in heading.

styles.name: subheading-app
styles.usage: A card's name where several cards sit side by side.

styles.name: control-app
styles.usage: Buttons, chips and table headers in the app.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands, file names (.mosaic, .tessera, pattern.yaml) and identifiers such as T-1889, inline or in blocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: title to description.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text, list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between sections in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutter between columns.

tokens.name: margin-print
tokens.usage: Side margin on A4 pieces (≈12.7 mm).

tokens.name: safe-edge
tokens.usage: Minimum clear space from any trimmed edge.

tokens.name: grout-print
tokens.usage: Gap between shards in print-size artwork and dividers.

tokens.name: grout-hero
tokens.usage: Gap between shards in 1920-wide hero artwork.

tokens.name: app-header
tokens.usage: Height of the app header band.

tokens.name: app-places
tokens.usage: Height of the app's row of places.

tokens.name: app-rail
tokens.usage: Width of a collapsed pane's rail.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Shards and tiles: never rounded, always irregular polygons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels around text.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citations, a thing's chip and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: App chips that are picked or removed: a 28px pill.
